rationale.faithfulness: The limit cycle fails with power: Lambda +0.05 inside the turn-shuffled null (p 0.08) where k = 0.6 cycles are found 100% and k = 0.3 74%; lag-1 correlation is positive (+0.16, p 0.002) in all variants, the opposite of a cycle; no direction or current. rationale.usefulness: A clean negative with a positive by-product: in debate formats content persists and echoes across the team line; opposition is visible in stance, not embedding dynamics.
